messages:
Maya: Quick kickoff 1min. Need a tight benchmark playbook for Wed webinar: latency vs token cost across three workloads. Deliver: 1 one-pager + 3 visuals + 2 social post variants + inbound routing. Who owns each?
Zoe: I can run queries and produce CSVs. Visuals: 1) latency waterfall (P50/P95/P99) by model variant; 2) tokens->$ Sankey showing batching + prefix cache savings; 3) regional latency vs $/k token heatmap.
Priya: Messaging: avoid "fastest". Use "predictable economics" and "graceful degradation." Hero: "Control inference spend while protecting latency SLOs."
Ben: I9ll do the slides and social crops. Layout horizontally so it fits a slide + social card. Colors: teal econ, slate text, orange tail callouts.
Aria: Routing: SMB -> trial CTA; Mid-market -> webinar + playbook; Enterprise -> demo + privacy brief. UTMs: `utm_campaign=bench_playbook&utm_segment={seg}`. Route Enterprise to AE if intent_score > 70.
Maya: Need two social tones: product (short) + ROI (longer). Also a 20-word reg blurb.
Priya: Product: "One API, predictable token economics 10 mins of benchmarks. Wed 11am PT. Register:" ROI: "Lower inference spend without breaking SLAs 
Live demo + benchmarks." 20-word: "Benchmarks and tactics to cut inference spend while keeping latency SLOs 
real workloads, routing, and cost playbooks"
Zoe: I'll attach query snippets for waterfall and Sankey; will include methodology and per-workload notes for legal.
Ben: Figma link coming. I'll add annotation showing how saved tokens are computed (batching + cache). Social crops + 1-slide export by EOD tomorrow.
Aria: I'll draft HubSpot webhook mapping and UTM table for ops and share playbook for routing automation.
Maya: Timeline: Zoe data EOD today, Ben mocks tomorrow noon, Priya copy EOD tomorrow, Aria routing doc Friday. I'll assemble one-pager Friday. Owners: Zoe=data, Ben=visuals, Priya=copy, Aria=routing. Thanks team :rocket:
